testcase.name: Scenario: Open a face context menu while an expansion is open: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:510:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a face context menu while an expansion is open ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned ✔ When the user right-clicks a visible solid face outside the expanded area ✔ Then the face context menu is displayed ✔ And the Modify additional command area remains visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the face context menu closes ✔ And the Modify additional command area closes ✔ And the face remains selected ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the face selection is cleared
